task_name: Build City Storage, Construct Hardware Store, and Place New Residential Zone

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: At City Level 4 when Advisor Eva prompts to place the City Storage building and the Commercial Buildings icon shows a '1' badge for the Hardware Store.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Placing City Storage increases base storage capacity from 30 to 40 and allows future capacity upgrades. Building the Hardware Store enables crafting Hammers, which are required for Level 4+ residential upgrades.
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Place City Storage and Hardware Store on the right end of the residential street where they do not cause pollution.

steps.who: green 'Show me' button on Eva's City Storage prompt

steps.briefing: drag City Storage onto the upper-right side of the main road and click the green checkmark.

steps.who: Commercial Buildings icon on the right menu

steps.briefing: drag the Hardware Store onto the road directly above City Storage and click the green checkmark.

steps.who: Residential Buildings icon on the right menu
steps.briefing: drag the available Residential Zone onto the right end of the residential road and click the green checkmark.
